datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Kenya to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications (ranging from minimal to catastrophic food insecurity) were compiled for multiple scenarios and time periods in 2022, with results distributed as spatial features (GeoJSON/KML) linked to administrative units.
